name: @olai/ops
//dependencies: Between `format` and `server` (docs/architecture.md): the ops layer knows what an edit MEANS and how a write is made durable, and nothing about a listener, a socket or a browser. @olai/format supplies the records, the rules, the canonical bytes and the refusal vocabulary; @olai/store supplies the one write gate. @olai/surface is deliberately absent — an op does not know it is being called over a wire.
//devDependencies: @effect/platform-node is the FileSystem the tests drive a real temp directory through, exactly as @olai/store's are. @types/node is for `node:child_process`, which the git hook shells out with.
